title: Quercetin in Coronary Artery By-pass Surgery

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to test the anti-inflammatory and anti-senescence effects of quercetin during coronary artery by-pass graft surgery.

Posted outcomes: Quercetin-associated Change in Surgery-associated Inflammation. timeframe=Baseline, 1 day and 4 days post-surgery. Placebo=9 (±5); Quercetin=3 (±1)
